content.title: ABC News: Breaking News Live - Apps on Google Play
content.text: Discover the power of staying informed with the ABC News app, your gateway to 24/7 breaking news coverage. Immerse yourself in the pulse of current events through live-streaming from ABC News Live, while keeping up with politics, weather, health, business and local headlines, all from America’s #1 news source.Start the day with a curated selection of stories and videos and stay up to date on the subjects that matter most to you with personalized news alerts. From national news to global headlines, the ABC News app has always got you covered.How to make the most of the ABC News experience:FOLLOW THE HOME SCREEN LIVE BLOGS & BREAKING NEWS BARGet to know the most important headlines as soon as they happen, directly on the home screen thanks to our live blog and breaking news banner. Politics? Economy? It’s never been easier to find the unbiased news you want to read.As the home screen is clearer, easier to read and more personalized to you than ever before, it's really hard to miss what's newsworthy!CUSTOMIZE YOUR PUSH ALERTSActivate your push notifications and get stories that you're interested in reading. It’s that simple!STREAM LIVE NEWS ANYWHERE Watch live news wherever you want. Whether you like to start your day with a morning news report or wrap up the day’s events with nightly news, ABC News Live covers all the information you need.US NEWSKeep up with the latest national news headlines on our live news feed. Discover the stories driving the country’s current conversations. From business news to your favorite entertainment news, never miss a minute of local news.WORLD NEWSWatch international news and stay updated with today's top stories in the ABC News app, your ultimate source for the world’s latest headlines. Get your daily unbiased news, watch in-depth analysis and keep in the loop with breaking news alerts as they unfold, only a few taps away.US ELECTIONS NEWSStay current with the 2024 primary election season and presidential debates with comprehensive coverage and deep analysis from ABC News and 538. Stream election news and get news alerts about presidential polls and election results.ABC WORLD NEWS TONIGHTABC World News Tonight with David Muir brings you daily news from all around the world. Catch the most watched network newscast in the US streaming in the ABC News app.ORIGINAL PROGRAMSFind expert analysis of the top stories in politics, business, health and all the topics that affect you on Nightline, This Week, 20/20, GMA, and other shows. Watch exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions on the day’s headline news.Download now and gain access to all the latest news in the palm of your hand: - Watch live news coverage from ABC News Live wherever you are- Get personalized push notifications on the stories that matter most to you- Follow every moment of the primary elections with real-time updates, forecasts, and analysis- Watch videos from your favorite ABC News broadcasts- Listen to ABC News podcasts, including ‘538’, the ‘Good Morning America’ podcast and our award-winning ‘Start Here’ daily show- Dark mode now available- Content loads faster than everYour California Privacy Rights: https://privacy.thewaltdisneycompany.com/en/current-privacy-policy/your-california-privac y-rights/Do Not Sell My Information: https://privacy.thewaltdisneycompany.com/en/dnsmiPlease note: This app features Nielsen’s proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen’s TV Ratings. Please see http://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information.
